digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention infrastructure: observability, gates, migrations, and validation
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation time and queryable via bug_trends metrics without requiring additional user input

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must prevent: raw git writes bypassing the store, unread config schema fields, missing wall-clock asserts in tests, unchecked acceptance criteria at close, and code comments with dead references
Reconciler transport must be fully typed end-to-end with property tests pinning declared field asymmetries and paginated iteration deduped into shared iterators
Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflow, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python per strangler-fig policy
Canary and automation bug filing must follow hardened dedup pattern with documented bug-creation contract and real review execution blocking oversized fixes without plan-review attestation
Code comments citing dead SHAs, run-ids, or dates must be remediated to ticket citations with CI regression prevention
